name: Interface inventory
description: List local interfaces, addresses, status and MTU.

name: Wireless interface inventory
description: Find Linux wireless interfaces without assuming a specific adapter name.

description: Compare current and previous scans by BSSID.

description: Summarise network counts, bands, security and average measured RSSI.

name: Vendor distribution
